key.name: terminal-command
key.description: Command the helper app uses to show server logs, where %s is replaced by the command to run. Leave empty to auto-detect an installed terminal.

key.name: symfony-path
key.description: Absolute path to the symfony binary. Leave empty to search PATH and the usual install locations.

key.name: polling-interval
key.description: Interval in seconds at which the helper app checks server and proxy state.

key.name: show-php-version
key.description: Whether to show the PHP version in the menu.

key.name: favorite-servers
key.description: List of server directory paths marked as favorites.

key.name: debug-logging
key.description: Enable verbose debug/info logging to the system journal. Disabled by default; enable only when troubleshooting.
